main_text.l: tur. Observat igitur Dallæus cap. 12. pag.
tim in libri limine, & Paulo post capite
quinto. Primum enim caput, inquit, ad
fixus ei titulus, & ipsa operis præfatio.
Quod hoc pacto probat, Irenæus Valen-
liani iocus, id nomen in sublimitatibus habi-
tanti minimè congruere ) una cum By-
paret: Ex Bytho in hanc Sigen immissio-
ret ) & cum eo Alethiam, id est verita-
tem: Nun porrò, & suam Alethiam emi-
sisse λόγον καὶ Ζωὴν Verbum & Vitam. Capi-
te inde quinto eadem apud Irenæum oc-
quem Bython priùs dixerat) & Sigen con-
tinens; tum altera ex hac prima prodiens

page.notes: The Greek word after "primò" (Ἀνὼς) is hard to read at the scan resolution and is marked [?]. The Greek after "emisisse" is a transliteration-free reading of λόγον καὶ Ζωὴν; the final letters are less certain. The page number 175 is partly smudged by ink. The final word "Alethiæ" is cut at the bottom of the text block. Dots and specks in the margins are not printed text.
